title: Royal Raymond Rife's microscope and frequency machine suppressed

tellings.quote: In the 1930s, Reife claimed to have invented a microscope so powerful it could observe live viruses.

plain: In the 1930s an inventor named Royal Raymond Rife claimed to have built a microscope so powerful it could watch live viruses, work said to have been pushed aside along with his frequency machine. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode with a pharmacy businessman named Brigham Buhler about the drug industry's past; if true, it would mean a major medical tool was lost or buried.
